title: Micks Picks - NFL Delaware Lottery Tickets

teams.name: Las Vegas Raiders
teams.guide: VSiN preseason LV 19.5 / KC 26. Fantasy Life treated QB transition and Bowers as central. Current 3-0 start and Bowers' return improve the old LV baseline; Chiefs remain stronger in independent power rankings.
teams.cash: Two paths: LV's 29.3 points/game and returning receiving centerpiece give it a scoring response; current VSiN forecast has a much tighter game than +4.5. Big +12.5 and Teaser +9.5 tolerate two-score and nine-point losses, respectively.
teams.counter: Kansas City's defense allows 16.7 points/game and 278 yards/game. LV's nine takeaways in three games may regress; a Chiefs ground-game lead can overwhelm the cushion.
teams.personnel: Jackson Powers-Johnson DNP, groin; Aidan O'Connell DNP, personal. The latter is not evidence that the starting QB is out. Bowers' Week 3 routes 92% and targets 41% support restored receiving role; current article incorrectly names Saints as Week 4 opponent, so use its utilization only.
teams.vsin: Dave Tuley: LV +4.5 best bet. Current game forecast favors KC by only 0.6. Preseason guide and independent powers still favor KC.
teams.docs: Josh Schonwald, Sept 29: Raiders +4.0. Half +4.5 improves his number. Big and Teaser are separately assessed derivatives, not an endorsed joint ticket.

teams.name: Tennessee Titans
teams.guide: VSiN preseason TEN 20.5 / BAL 28.5. Fantasy Life's Cam Ward development prior is retained modestly; current scoring 12.3/game prevents declaring an offensive turnaround.
teams.cash: Two paths: TEN's last two defeats were by four and five; Baltimore has allowed 26 points/game and can permit late scoring. +11.5 is above ten, and Big +19.5 allows a 19-point defeat.
teams.counter: Ravens average 30.7 points and 167.3 rushing yards. TEN's low-output offense may not keep pace; the VSiN projected margin is essentially at the Half Point number.
teams.personnel: Lamar Jackson limited, back; Zay Flowers limited, hamstring; Ravens offensive-line/secondary limitations. John Franklin-Myers DNP, back for TEN. Jackson's limitation is not an OUT designation.
teams.vsin: Dave Tuley: TEN +11.5 best bet. Forecast BAL by 11.4 is neutral at the straight threshold rather than strong model confirmation.
teams.docs: Josh Schonwald: TEN +11.5; Jeremy Block's Sept 30 movement report also expects TEN to cover. Both are one Doc's source family.

teams.name: Los Angeles Rams
teams.guide: VSiN preseason LAR 29.5 / PHI 27. Fantasy Life emphasizes Stafford-Nacua-Adams and Williams/Corum. Current independent powers 5.6 vs 0.5 retain a Rams advantage, but 1-2 start and six turnovers weaken the runaway-favorite prior.
teams.cash: Two paths: Rams have 1,253 yards through three games and rank third in yards allowed, versus PHI's 302.3 yards/game and zero defensive takeaways. Half -2.5 stays below three; Big +5.5/Teaser +2.5 need competitive play, not a multi-score win.
teams.counter: Rams scoring is only 20.3/game despite volume; turnover and red-zone failures can recur. PHI's rushing game can control possession. VSiN margin 2.4 is near the Half threshold.
teams.personnel: Aaron Donald DNP, back; Jaylen Watson DNP, shoulder; Josh Wallace limited. PHI Fred Johnson DNP, knee; Jordan Davis and Moro Ojomo limited. Final OL/secondary composition still pending.
teams.vsin: Tuley leans LAR but explicitly passes the game; forecast LAR by 2.4 is slight support for competitive-game derivatives, not an emphatic -2.5 cover.
teams.docs: Tony Sink: Rams -3.0 on Sept 29. Half -2.5 is better; positive-point derivatives are separately assessed.

teams.name: Washington Commanders
teams.guide: VSiN preseason both 23. Fantasy Life's Daniels rushing/receiving ceiling is reduced for elbow injury; Mariota's current play overrides a healthy-Daniels assumption. Neutral-site travel replaces a home-field assumption.
teams.cash: Two paths: IND has allowed 417.3 yards/game and 30.3 points; WAS has a credible Mariota-led scoring route after beating SEA. +11.5 and +8.5 provide protection beyond the model's IND 4.7 margin.
teams.counter: Washington allows 30.7 points/game and 280.3 passing yards; Indianapolis can attack that secondary. Half +3.5 is worse than current Circa +4 and has little model protection.
teams.personnel: Jayden Daniels limited, elbow; Sam Cosmi DNP, concussion/throat. Assess both Mariota continuation and Daniels return; neither can be declared Sunday's starter yet.
teams.vsin: Tuley passes and prefers IND. Current forecast opposes WAS +3.5; Makinen systems are mixed. Derivative buffer is the Micks judgment.
teams.docs: Guy Bruhn and Spencer Toth: WAS +3.5. Jeremy Block also supports WAS, but describes it as home: incorrect for London. Discount that premise.

teams.name: Jacksonville Jaguars
teams.guide: VSiN preseason JAX/CIN both 24; current independent powers JAX 5.0, CIN 2.9 and JAX defense 12 points/game favor a competitive contest. Fantasy Life's Lawrence/receiving-role prior stays a baseline, not a current projection.
teams.cash: Two paths: Jaguars allow 12 points/game and 3.6 yards/rush; their offense scored 27.3/game and dismantled NE. Big +9.5 crosses both three and seven and tolerates a nine-point defeat.
teams.counter: Cincinnati's passing offense and a 52-point current total create wider margins. VSiN forecasts CIN by 3.9; Doc's teaser specialist passes JAX because of high-total risk.
teams.personnel: JAX Van Lanen knee, Hamilton back and defensive-front players limited; CIN Risner knee and B.J. Hill Achilles DNP. Monitor trench losses before assuming the defensive floor.
teams.vsin: Tuley specifically recommends JAX +8.5 teasers; Big +9.5 is better. That is not a straight +2.5 recommendation; model and several Makinen trends favor CIN.
teams.docs: Guy Bruhn: JAX +2.5. Jeremy Block's teaser report explicitly passes this leg. Show the disagreement inside one factor.

teams.name: Los Angeles Chargers
teams.guide: VSiN preseason LAC 24.5 / SEA 29.5. Fantasy Life Herbert-led passing and run-game prior is downweighted: current offense 14.7 points/game and six turnovers. Independent powers also favor SEA.
teams.cash: Two paths: Half +7.5 keeps the full touchdown; Tuley and a Makinen system support LAC after competitive losses. A clean turnover game creates a cover route, but current offensive weakness limits conviction.
teams.counter: SEA leads the independent power board and allows 16.7 points/game. VSiN margin 10.8 beats the Half cushion; Doc's picks SEA -7. This is the weakest Half ticket leg.
teams.personnel: Backup Trey Lance limited, groin; do not mistake that for an injured Herbert designation. SEA Reed foot and Zabel groin limited. Current SEA QB role/final status must be reconciled before release.
teams.vsin: Dave Tuley: LAC +7 best, prefers +7.5; Makinen system supports LAC. Current forecast directly opposes +7.5.
teams.docs: Guy Bruhn: Seahawks -7.0. Opposing verified selection earns 1/10, not missing-source treatment.

teams.name: Dallas Cowboys
teams.guide: VSiN preseason DAL 24 / HOU 24.5. Current independent ratings DAL 1.4/HOU 0.9 and scoring 29.3 vs 18.0 challenge the assumed Houston edge; Dallas defense remains a concern.
teams.cash: Two paths: Cowboys have a scoring response against HOU's 25 points/game allowed; HOU's 84.7 rushing yards/game limits its clock-killing path. Big +9.5 exceeds Tuley's +8.5 threshold and passes three/seven.
teams.counter: Dallas allows 179.7 rushing yards and 27.3 points/game. Houston's run defense is stronger; a Texans offensive recovery or Nico Collins return can change the game.
teams.personnel: DAL Durant and Revel DNP; HOU Trent Brown DNP and multiple rushers limited. Nico Collins return/role remains an explicit check.
teams.vsin: Dave Tuley: DAL +8.5 teasers; Big +9.5 qualifies. The regular card's +6.5 fails that threshold.
teams.docs: Tony Sink: HOU -2.5, opposing side. Jeremy Block lists Dallas +8.5 as potential but his final two-leg pick is CLE/DEN. These are not full Doc's agreement.

teams.name: Denver Broncos
teams.guide: VSiN preseason DEN 27 / SF 27.5. Fantasy Life notes Nix rushing and a Dobbins/Harvey committee; current comeback is encouraging, but DEN averages only 20 points/game.
teams.cash: Two paths: DEN's defense allows 21 points/game and SF's injured front can improve protection; +9.5 remains above both capper +8.5 thresholds and the forecast's 5.8 margin.
teams.counter: SF's Purdy-McCaffrey offense and independent power edge can produce a two-score win. Denver cannot depend on another 16-point comeback; low rushing efficiency can force high-variance passing.
teams.personnel: SF Nick Bosa DNP, knee/calf; Trent Williams DNP, rest/neck; additional secondary limitations. Verify actual designations rather than promote DNP to OUT.
teams.vsin: Dave Tuley: DEN +8.5 teasers. VSiN forecast SF by 5.8 still leaves Big +9.5 room; regular Teaser +6.5 does not match his recommendation.
teams.docs: Jeremy Block's final teaser pick includes DEN +8.5; Tony Sink DEN +3.0. Spencer Toth instead picks SF -2.5. Partial agreement with explicit counterweight.

teams.name: Atlanta Falcons
teams.guide: VSiN preseason ATL 21.5 / NO 22.5. Fantasy Life Penix/Bijan run-game prior now has support from Penix's return and the win over GB, but not a claim all QB uncertainty is resolved.
teams.cash: Two paths: Atlanta averages 173 rushing yards and allows 47.7 rushing yards; a controlled divisional game can stay close. Big +9.5 is above Tuley's +8.5 threshold and forecast NO by 5.3.
teams.counter: ATL has eight turnovers and a weak pass defense; Shough and home-field NO can create a margin beyond nine. Monday adds more time for personnel changes.
teams.personnel: Penix's current comeback replaces the preseason QB assumption. Monday final injury report is not yet published; verify offensive-line and receiving availability.
teams.vsin: Tuley: ATL +8.5 teasers. Regular +6.5 is too short. Current forecast favors NO by 5.3.
teams.docs: Tony Sink: NO -3.0. Jeremy Block calls ATL +8.5 playable but hesitant, and omits it from his final teaser pair.

teams.name: New England Patriots
teams.guide: VSiN preseason NE 27 / BUF 28.5. Fantasy Life Maye/Stevenson/Henderson priors are sharply reduced for six INTs, 12 points/game and current role split; do not assume a Super Bowl offense persists.
teams.cash: Two paths: NE defense allows 17 points/game and 278.3 yards/game; +14.5 crosses fourteen, and +12.5 retains twelve. Buffalo's 26 points/game conceded permits a backdoor score.
teams.counter: Bills average 33.7 points/game; Maye's turnovers can create short fields and a blowout. VSiN predicts a 9.5-point Bills win, opposing straight +6.5.
teams.personnel: NE Barmore, Gonzalez and Moses DNP; BUF Benford DNP and Walker limited. Stevenson has 53% snaps but 29% rush share; rushing committee complicates low-volume offensive recovery.
teams.vsin: Tuley NE +6.5; Makinen has both NE support and BUF trends. Model favors BUF by 9.5; derivatives independently judged.
teams.docs: Josh Schonwald NE +7.0. This is weaker than current Half +6.5, but Big/Teaser cushion helps after separate analysis. Jeremy Block expects BUF to win by seven.

teams.name: Green Bay Packers
teams.guide: VSiN preseason GB 26.5 / TB 23. Current powers -2.0/-2.4 show both weaker than the old baseline. Fantasy Life's Mayfield prior cannot be carried forward unadjusted with thumb injury.
teams.cash: Two paths: Big +4.5 lets GB lose by four rather than needing a -3.5 cover; TB's 279.3 yards/game and QB uncertainty limit sustained scoring. Current forecast has GB ahead.
teams.counter: GB is allowing 30.3 points/game and averages only 48.7 rushing yards. A healthy Mayfield or surprising Daniels performance defeats a QB-injury fade.
teams.personnel: Mayfield DNP, thumb; Jalon Daniels replacement reported but Sunday starter not final. GB Banks and Monk DNP and multiple defensive linemen limited/out of practice.
teams.vsin: Tuley passes; Makinen has fades on both sides. Forecast GB by 3.7 supports derivative protection but not a named GB teaser endorsement.
teams.docs: Guy Bruhn: TB +3.5. Opposes GB direction; no exact Big +4.5 pick recovered.

teams.name: Seattle Seahawks
teams.guide: VSiN preseason SEA 29.5 / LAC 24.5. Current independent power rank first, defense 16.7 points/game and 367.7 offensive yards support Seattle even after a turnover-driven loss.
teams.cash: Two paths: defense suppresses an LAC offense at 14.7 points/game; passing attack generated 437 yards against WAS. Big +1.5 tolerates a one-point loss and does not require covering seven.
teams.counter: Seattle's QB role must be current, not an automatic healthy-Darnold assumption. LAC can improve turnover discipline; Tuley's straight opinion backs LAC.
teams.personnel: Reed foot and Zabel groin limited. Confirm Seattle starting QB and receiving/trench availability; assess Lock continuation if Darnold unavailable.
teams.vsin: Forecast SEA by 10.8, but Tuley and one Makinen system select LAC. No exact SEA Big Teaser endorsement.
teams.docs: Guy Bruhn SEA -7.0. Direction supports SEA, but +1.5 is a different threshold requiring separate judgment.

teams.name: Minnesota Vikings
teams.guide: VSiN preseason MIN 23 / MIA 18.5. Fantasy Life explicitly has Kyler Murray in MIN; its Achane-centric Miami prior is obsolete after season-ending ACL injury. New Gordon-led committee is not equivalent.
teams.cash: Two paths: MIN defense allows 13.7 points/game and Miami scores 12; Big -3.5 only needs a four-point win against a depleted, low-volume offense.
teams.counter: MIN is last in offensive yards at 238.3/game; defensive scores and takeaways can regress. A tight low-possession game makes even -3.5 fragile.
teams.personnel: Achane season-ending ACL confirmed in current Fantasy Life report; Gordon 82% Week 3 snaps can split with Wright/Hunter. MIN Demmings DNP, hamstring; Murray/final offensive lineup check remains.
teams.vsin: Forecast MIN by 13; Tuley passes and Makinen system supports MIA +10.5. Do not count every VSiN item as confirmation.
teams.docs: Guy Bruhn MIA +11.5. A Dolphins eleven-point cover can coexist with MIN -3.5, but that is not a named MIN teaser selection.

teams.name: Cleveland Browns
teams.guide: VSiN preseason CLE 20.5 / PIT 23. Fantasy Life run-game/Watson prior is modified for Jenkins absence and Warren's large Pittsburgh role. Current 2-1 CLE is not automatically stronger than PIT.
teams.cash: Two paths: VSiN forecast has CLE winning a low-total home rivalry; current capper support emphasizes defense and competitive divisional scores. Big +9.5 is better than Doc's +8.5; regular +6.5 only protects a six-point loss.
teams.counter: Cleveland's missing center/guard Jenkins weakens protection; Pittsburgh can pressure Watson and Warren's increased volume can control possession. Independent powers still favor PIT.
teams.personnel: Official team report: Elgton Jenkins OUT, concussion; PIT Dowdle OUT, toe; Ramsey wrist and Echols concussion questionable. Warren Week 3 snaps 91%, rush share 85%; Pittsburgh offense has a real personnel-supported countercase.
teams.vsin: Tuley CLE +3. Makinen has conflicting CLE trends. Forecast favors CLE, but straight pick is not an exact +6.5 teaser recommendation.
teams.docs: Jeremy Block final teaser pair CLE +8.5 and DEN +8.5. Big +9.5 improves it; regular +6.5 is two points worse and fails that advertised threshold. Ryan Cobbett's Sept 30 TNF report instead takes PIT -2.5 and Under 38.5 on the protection matchup; his questionable labels are superseded by today's official OUT designations.

teams.name: Arizona Cardinals
teams.guide: VSiN preseason ARI 17.5 / NYG 22. Fantasy Life's Love committee prior has changed: 63% snaps, 78% carries and a 91 utilization score. Brissett-led offense has outperformed low preseason expectations; Giants QB instability is part of the countercase.
teams.cash: Two paths: improved Love rushing role and a competitive 36-30 SF defeat support an offensive response; Big +8.5 crosses three/seven and is larger than either current forecast's small margin.
teams.counter: Current independent powers still put NYG above ARI; Skattebo's 78% snaps/65% routes give Giants a credible ground-and-checkdown path. Love's health and goal-line rotation remain unresolved.
teams.personnel: Love carries a questionable flag on current player content; Froholdt and Nolen limited. NYG Andrew Thomas DNP, groin. Do not assume Dart or any preseason QB is Sunday's confirmed starter.
teams.vsin: Tuley passes; forecast NYG by 0.9 and mixed Makinen trends. No exact ARI +8.5 selection.
teams.docs: Josh Schonwald NYG -1.5 in older advance report; this direction conflicts with ARI, and favorite has since flipped. Jeremy Block passes the game.

teams.name: Carolina Panthers
teams.guide: VSiN preseason CAR 22 / DET 26. Current CAR passing 295.7 yards/game and DET 31.7 points/game allowed improve Carolina's competitive path, but Panthers run defense is extremely weak.
teams.cash: Two paths: CAR's passing attack can exploit DET's 299.3 passing yards/game conceded; +11.5 permits an eleven-point loss in a game the VSiN forecast gives CAR outright.
teams.counter: CAR allows 193.3 rushing yards/game. Gibbs and Detroit's 31 points/game can build a lead, particularly if Carolina's offensive-line injuries force punts.
teams.personnel: Monroe Freeling DNP, concussion; G Damien Lewis DNP, elbow. Current Jameson Williams 90% routes but 16% targets/0.4 YAC is a role-efficiency concern, not evidence he is out.
teams.vsin: Current forecast favors CAR by 3.1; one Makinen system fades DET. Tuley passes; no exact Big +11.5 endorsement.
teams.docs: Josh Schonwald and Spencer Toth select DET -3.5; both are opposing current opinions. Their Detroit rushing path is the strongest countercase.

tickets.name: Half Point A - preferred 3-pick build
tickets.notes: Best of the two Half Point structures. All three stay on the same side as a named current Doc's selection. Sunday's final injury and guide/current-projection reconciliation still control official release.

tickets.name: Half Point B - alternate 3-pick build
tickets.notes: Lower confidence: LAC is only B- and has both a VSiN forecast and Doc's side against it; WAS +3.5 is worse than current Circa +4. Do not treat this as equal strength to A.

tickets.name: Big Teaser A - 10 picks
tickets.notes: DAL/JAX/DEN/ATL are at +9.5, exceeding Tuley's +8.5 teaser recommendations. GB is the weakest leg: quarterback uncertainty and poor current run offense. This ticket includes Monday and has no same-game pair.

tickets.name: Big Teaser B - 10 picks
tickets.notes: Five shared legs with A, five distinct replacements. Includes Thursday CLE, so acceptance must precede 8:15 p.m. ET. ARI is the weakest leg, with Giants/Arizona source disagreement. No opposite sides of the same event across the two Big Teasers.

tickets.name: Teaser - 4 picks
tickets.notes: Four-leg build as requested. CLE +6.5 does not reach Doc's +8.5 standard-teaser recommendation; it is independently assessed and deliberately marked lower confidence. LV/WAS cross seven, NE crosses ten. No blanket claim this is a standard six-point Wong teaser.

sourceNotes: Research completed October 1, 2026. The current VSiN Circa tracker exposed Full Game followed by 1st Half in one page; only its first, full-game table is used.
Dropbox NFL Week 4 PDF fetched and visually checked: uploaded Oct 1 at 12:37 p.m. ET, but printed update Sep 28, 8:38 a.m. It is a dated baseline, not today's executable Circa offer.

All 15 Sunday/Monday Doc's free matchup reports and Ryan Cobbett's Thursday report were read in full; authors and exact selections recorded. Jeremy Block teaser/movement and Spencer Toth opening reports were also read. Paid AI-v3 outputs were not exposed.
VSiN current game projections, Dave Tuley's Week 4 article and Steve Makinen's Week 4 systems/trends were read. Models, trends and individual capper opinions can conflict and remain one VSiN family.

Fantasy Life magazine NFL team snapshots were read, plus current Dwain McFarland Week 4 utilization and early Matthew Freedman ranking commentary. Full team-wide weekly projection grid was not exposed; no numerical delta is fabricated.
Fantasy Life's Bowers early-ranking article mislabels his opponent as Saints; actual card has KC. Its Week 3 utilization is usable; its listed Week 4 matchup boost is excluded.
Doc's teaser report has duplicated/opposing spread text and stale totals; exact final CLE +8.5/DEN +8.5 recommendations are verified but published totals are not substituted for current Circa.
Official NFL.com provider yielded 258 practice records dated Sep 30; fresh retrieval does not make them Oct 1 practice. Official CLE team page separately supplies final Thursday designations.
Current TeamRankings powers supply an independent matchup path. They are ratings, not Micks probabilities or exact fair spreads.

Public splits/handle were not reliably exposed. Market score is reference 5 + verified opening/current timing 3 + splits 0. Where opening matches current, that proves no observed spread move; it does not establish sharp money.

Progressive Fade/Favorite Inflation scans considered win/loss streaks, turnover-driven results, ATS direction and guide-current divergences. Partial game histories cannot certify every multi-game trigger; unverified triggers remain UNKNOWN.
Weekend kickoff weather, final starter/lineup status and full weekly projection deltas remain release blockers. No weather assumption receives a verified-clear label.
